name: mediabunny
input_api: new Input({ source: new BufferSource(bytes), formats: ALL_FORMATS }); getFormat(); getPrimaryAudioTrack(); new EncodedPacketSink(track).packets(); track.computeDuration()
scope: Every MPEG Layer III frame of an untagged stream from local bytes, demuxed by mediabunny's own frame-header reader: format, codec, sample rate, channels, frame count, frame bytes, samples per channel (from duration); no audio decode
family_note: Own frame-header reader (dist/modules/src/mp3/mp3-reader.js, mp3-demuxer.js). Not one of the ten mp3_id3v2/javascript paths; that cell's music-metadata path is a separate MPEG frame parser and its @audio/decode paths use mpg123 WASM. mediabunny also has an ID3 reader (id3.js) that the untagged controls do not exercise.
